verdict.rationale: Figma's docs confirm interactive, high-fidelity, no-code prototyping and dedicated animation/motion tooling (figma-docs-16, figma-docs-33, figma-docs-28), supporting the general story of prototypes feeling like the real product. However, the evidence pack never explicitly documents advanced logic features like variables, conditional interactions, or scroll-triggered effects within prototypes. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of variables/conditional logic in prototypes, scroll-effect interactions, and independent hands-on validation of these advanced behaviors.
